description: WRITE: Modify a LIVE subscription — change plan/tier (variant_id), cancel, pause/unpause, or set the billing anchor. This affects a real customer's billing. API: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}.

billing_anchor.description: Day of month (1-31) to anchor billing to.

cancelled.description: Set true to cancel, false to un-cancel.

pause.description: Pause object (mode, resumes_at), or null to unpause.

variant_id.description: New variant id to switch the plan/tier to.

name: lemonsqueezy_update_subscription
title: Update subscription
